overall_vibe: Moody, tactile, sophisticated, rooted in local alpine heritage. High-fashion editorial approach replacing standard restaurant templates.

primary_headings.usage: H1, H2, large editorial quotes, manifesto chapter titles.
primary_headings.guideline: Use high contrast sizing (e.g. text-6xl to 8xl for hero, tight tracking, leading-none).

secondary_body.usage: Body text, navigation, buttons, small captions.
secondary_body.guideline: Clean, humanist but slightly idiosyncratic sans to contrast with the sharp serif. No generic fonts like Inter/Roboto.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Extreme contrast between massive headings and small, readable body copy (e.g., jump from text-6xl to text-base). Asymmetrical alignments.

mattone.role: Dominant Brand Identity (impactful headers, immersive hero containers, structural footers, statement event modules)

terracotta.role: Dynamic Interactions (hover states, interactive content cards, minimalist iconography)

crema.role: Warm Organic Canvas (replaces pure white for long scrolling sections and digital menus, tactile paper feel)

beige.role: Structural Dividers (ultra-thin delicate boundary lines between editorial sections, e.g., border-beige)

marrone_scuro.role: Editorial Typography (high-impact titles, primary typographic focal points)

nero_caldo.role: Soft Contrast (replaces pure black for refined low-glare body contrast)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy (p-12 to p-32). Extreme asymmetry, breaking the standard grid.

layout_modes.editorial_split: Split-screen layouts where typography breathes on one side (Crema bg) next to cinematic high-contrast imagery on the other.
layout_modes.masonry: Overlapping asymmetric image grids for galleries.
layout_modes.dividers: Use ultra-thin borders using the Beige (#E8D9C3) color to separate sections without heavy blocks.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Smooth momentum scroll using `lenis`. High-end feel.
motion_and_interactions.cursor: Custom slow-inertia cursor (Framer Motion) replacing default pointer.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states trigger subtle shifts in background warmth (e.g., Crema fading slightly into a warm amber glow).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Framer-motion scroll reveals, parallax hero moment, on-load masked line-by-line text reveal for the kinetic hero.

textures_and_visuals.lighting: Deep shadows, warm amber glows reminiscent of string lights at dusk. Use radial gradients or blurred drop-shadows with Terracotta/Mattone tones.
textures_and_visuals.textures: Incorporate subtle grain/noise overlays to simulate tactile paper or wood grain.
textures_and_visuals.ui_elements: No pure whites or pure blacks. All borders must use Beige (#E8D9C3).

navigation.style: Floating semi-transparent pill navigation. Glassmorphism but warm (Crema with backdrop-blur-md and a 1px solid Beige border). NO completely transparent backgrounds.

hero.style: Kinetic hero. Full-screen in Mattone or high-contrast image overlay.
hero.features: Signature on-load masked line-by-line text reveal (tagline 'È come stare a casa') framed by delicate beige lines.

menu_section.style: Crema background, multi-column editorial typography. Looks like a high-fashion magazine spread.
menu_section.features: Pizzas, cucina, takeaway indicators. Use Marrone scuro for section titles.

storia_manifesto.style: Numbered chapters (01 Tradizione, 02 Serietà, 03 Punto iconico). Massive typography for numbers.
storia_manifesto.layout: Asymmetrical text blocks alongside historic imagery.

events_blocks.style: Mattone (#8E3721) background blocks with Crema text.

gallery.style: Borderless masonry grid + lightbox for expanding images.
gallery.features: Hover states on images create a subtle scale effect (1.05) with darkened overlay.

marquee.style: Slow editorial marquee. Serif typography, massive scale, slow continuous drift.

reservation_widget.style: WhatsApp deep-link button fixed at bottom-right or in navigation. Terracotta background, Crema icon.

pages.Homepage: The core experience. Combines Hero, Story intro, Menu highlights, Events preview, and Gallery. All smoothly connected via Lenis scrolling.

hero_historic_building.description: Historic alpine Italian building at twilight. Use as parallax hero background.

neapolitan_pizza_1.description: Neapolitan pizza baking in rustic wood-fired oven. Use for Menu highlights.

neapolitan_pizza_2.description: Round cooked pizza. Use for Menu.

ambiance_string_lights.description: Moody warm string lights at dusk. Use for ambiance/gallery sections.

live_music_event.description: Live music intimate dark venue. Use for Eventi section blocks.

wood_texture.description: Rustic dark wood grain texture. Can be used as a low opacity overlay or section background.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses proper overlays for APCA/WCAG contrast minimums. Nero Caldo text on Crema bg is perfect.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serifs for headings. Follow typography guidelines strictly.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and generous spacing (p-12 to p-32).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but never pure transparent backgrounds for text-bearing surfaces.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions, parallax effects, entrance animations). Static = dead.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment and editorial layouts.
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`), as it breaks transforms.
